tagline: 理光胶片相机，1963 年发布
description: 理光于1963年推出的胶片相机。

specs.英文简介: The Ricohmatic 126 is a 1960s camera by Riken/Ricoh using 126 film cartridges, whose metal finish shows much more refinement than the typical Instamatic.The Rikenon 35mm f/2.8 lens uses scale focusing and is surrounded by a selenium meter cell.
